title: PocketGull Font Superfamily: Optotypically Calibrated Clinical, Mathematical, Astronomical & Telemetry Vector Letterforms
description: PocketGull is an open-source clinical sans-serif, display, mathematical, and telemetry monospace font superfamily designed for digital health applications, critical care patient monitoring, observational astronomy, STEM publishing, and sovereign multi-script literacy. Engineered on a 1000 UPM grid conforming to ISO/IEC 14496-22 and Google Fonts specifications with LogMAR 0.0 Louise Sloan 5:1 optotypic legibility, PocketGull features 256 Unicode Braille patterns (U+2800..U+28FF), ISMP/FDA numeral disambiguation (slashed zero cv08, curved lowercase l cv05, serifed capital I ss02, slashed Z cv11), Herman Bouma lateral anti-crowding spacing, Scotopic 650nm dark-sky red mode for astronomical observatories, 80-column FITS header compliance, robust 68 UPM math stem weights with OpenType MATH tables (LaTeX CTAN / Typst universe), gapless ICU telemetry box drawing (U+2500..U+257F) with sub-cell plethysmograph/ECG waveforms, and native multi-script support for Canadian Aboriginal Syllabics (Inuktitut), Chinuk Pipa, Cherokee Syllabary, Neo-Tifinagh, Ethiopic Ge'ez, Adlam, Vai, and Pan-Tribal North American Indigenous orthographies under the CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Sovereignty.
